name: Debt Management Credit Counseling Corp
description_short: Nonprofit credit counseling organization offering free budget counseling, debt management plans, and housing advice through HUD-certified and certified credit counselors.
description_long:
Debt Management Credit Counseling Corp. (DMCC) is a nonprofit credit counseling organization that has been operating for over 20 years, serving more than 100,000 consumers. The organization is structured as a tax-exempt nonprofit dedicated to educating consumers on financial issues and providing personal assistance to those struggling with debt.

DMCC offers a comprehensive suite of services including debt management plans, debt reduction programs, payday loan repayment plans, student loan relief, credit score analysis, budget counseling, bankruptcy certificates, credit report assistance, HUD-certified homebuyer education, foreclosure prevention counseling, rental assistance, and reverse mortgage counseling. The company operates through certified credit counselors who provide personalized guidance. DMCC has partnered with Take Charge America, Inc. to administer debt repayment programs for its referrals.

DMCC distinguishes itself through its dual focus on debt management and housing counseling, offering HUD-certified counselors for home-related issues. The organization provides free financial education through DMCC University, which includes videos, online courses, homebuyer workshops, partner programs, and financial articles. According to their website, they have helped clients pay off $500 million in debt with an average interest rate of 8.2% and average payment reduction of 24%.

As a nonprofit counseling organization, DMCC is positioned as a free-to-low-cost option for consumers seeking debt management assistance. However, the website provides limited detail about specific pricing, success rates, or accreditation credentials (such as NFCC membership). The partnership with Take Charge America for debt repayment administration should be verified for transparency regarding any fees consumers may encounter.
pros: Nonprofit organization with 20+ years of operating history serving 100,000+ consumers
Free initial consultation and debt quote calculation through certified credit counselors
Offers comprehensive services beyond debt management: housing counseling, HUD-certified homebuyer education, foreclosure prevention
Free financial education through DMCC University with videos, online courses, and articles
Reported average payment reduction of 24% and $500M+ in total debt paid off by clients
Certified credit counselors provide personalized one-on-one assistance
Addresses multiple debt types: credit cards, payday loans, and student loans
cons: Website lacks transparency about NFCC certification status or specific accreditation details
Limited information about actual fees or costs associated with debt management plans
Partners with Take Charge America for debt repayment administration—potential third-party involvement in financial decisions
No clear information about average timeframe for debt payoff or program completion
Website does not disclose specific default rates, customer satisfaction metrics, or independent reviews
best_for: Consumers with multiple credit card debts seeking to lower interest rates through management plans
Homeowners facing foreclosure or seeking HUD-certified counseling for home purchase/maintenance
Individuals with payday loans or student loan debt looking for structured repayment alternatives
diagnosis: DMCC is best for consumers with moderate-to-high credit card debt or housing concerns who want free professional counseling from certified advisors without aggressive sales tactics typical of for-profit debt settlement companies. The main caveat is that limited website transparency regarding accreditation, fees, and measurable outcomes makes independent verification of their credentials and track record important before enrolling.
services: Debt Management Plans for credit cards
typical_results_timeline: Counseling available within 1-2 weeks of contact.
